description:
[read-only] Per-account metrics and tag, campaign, experiment and series roll-ups. Omit postId for scope-wide roll-ups (up to 100 posts). Include reruns to compare bookings of the same content over time. Historical data stays platform-attributed. Pro plan or higher.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/analytics/instances.)

brandId.description: Brand id or all; brand-bound keys remain pinned.

includeReruns.description: Compare all readable bookings of the same contentId.

postId.description: Local Flayr post id; omit for roll-ups across the readable scope (up to 100 posts).

name: compare_post_instances
title: Compare post instances and reruns
